jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.165.1 to 1.165.2. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.165.1 to 1.165.2. In README.md change every 1.165.1 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.165.2. In these tests replace the 1.165.1 pin with 1.165.2 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.165.2 above the 1.165.1 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: No money figure is left on Swarm Watch. And these bullets with a bold lead word like the 1.165.1 entry: Board: the orchestrator panel, run pages, plan views, API responses, event stream, history and CSV carry no money figures; NO CAP shows as a plain warning; a test requests every route and scans every board script and page for money. | Board: one percent function everywhere, activity counted across every checkout and scratch folder, installed version shown, nameless projects hidden, finished projects as a quiet card. Change nothing else. Run the six listed test files; all must pass. ignoreTests reason: only version pins and the changelog change; the fixture ledger is a frozen data copy.
